label: 方式执行先导 (structured request; NOT a language end-to-end test)
purpose: show that T5 reuses the shared manner layer and produces a language-required physical change in the specified stage (place descent) only

requests.N: 把书放入后部隔间，松开并退出。 -> intents=[] (neutral, all stages normal)
requests.S: 把书缓慢放入后部隔间，松开并退出。 -> structured intent (stage=place, dimension=speed, level=slow); sentence->binding NOT tested here

N.all_stages: shared normal level v_max=0.12 m/s, w_max=1.0 (== frozen ordinary plan, untouched)

S.place_stage: shared slow default v_max=0.06 m/s, w_max=min(3.0, v/0.12)=0.5 (candidate_plan rotation coupling)

shared_layer_reused: frozen T5 ordinary protocol (GUARD, GripPlan, s15 judgement fields)

time_budget_rule.rule: max_steps stays at the shared default 250 for EVERY stage in BOTH conditions; no per-init change
time_budget_rule.reachability_arithmetic: place descent ~0.17 m; slow 0.06 m/s * dt 0.05 s = 3 mm/step -> ~57 steps nominal << 250 (4x margin); commanded speed is an upper bound, realised speed is measured
time_budget_rule.check: no stage timeout and status==completed in dev runs; record descent step counts

windows.descent: place-stage control steps k with place_start <= k < release_start  (SPEED WINDOW)
windows.retreat: retreat stage (not counted as slow descent)

speed_metric: manner_calibration.eef_speed_mps (state->next_state xyz / dt); mean, median, p95, duration, path length per window

criteria.status: pre-registered WORKING thresholds, not validated (commanded ratio is 0.5; realised ratio is an outcome to be reported)
criteria.absolute: dev-derived slow_upper (midpoint of slow max / normal min of per-run descent median speed, shared separation rule) from dev inits only; labelled development calibration n=4/level; applied unchanged to new inits
criteria.manner_pass: pair_manner_pass = ratio_mean<=0.75 AND ratio_duration>=1.33 (+ absolute criterion on new inits when the dev threshold exists)

post_release_reported_separately: M3 final origin / z margin to official In lower bound
prefix_check: bitwise equality of state/actions/next_state/dt/book pose/forces/stage labels on steps < place_start between N and S

inits.new_note: fixed before any run; not used for any T5 tuning (T5 policy runs used inits 0-7; scene-only static inspection used 0-7 and 14-21); inits 4-7 are excluded because they served ordinary-execution validation
